question: Does toxic give a player poison counters if the creature with toxic deals combat damage to a creature or planeswalker?

expected.shortAnswer: No: toxic works only when the creature deals combat damage to a player.
expected.answer: If a creature with toxic deals combat damage to a creature or planeswalker, or if it deals noncombat damage, toxic has no effect and no player gets poison counters.

whyHard: Toxic adds poison counters on top of normal damage, so players think it applies to any combat damage.
